scope: read-only product; no browser; preparation only

commonCriteria.name: Whole composition
commonCriteria.test: Open full originals. Judge field plus entire roster/status region against full-frame center; compare top/bottom and left/right outer negative space. A boundedrect or a single centered child is insufficient.

commonCriteria.name: Rail/card relationships
commonCriteria.test: Compare full sidebar envelope with field or prompt/answer card. Center contents as a group in its real available height. Inspect two/four/sixteen roster differences where owner evidence exists; never stretch rows purely to fillspace.

commonCriteria.name: Shared header facts
commonCriteria.test: Title/timer/current actor/facts must sit optically centered in their available columns with comparable top/bottom breathing room. Check literalglyph ink, italic overshoot, longesttitle/longname and0/1/7, not only DOMboxes.

commonCriteria.name: No unwanted ornaments
commonCriteria.test: Reject decorative dashes, stitches, isolated edgebars and corner brackets on TV/phone. Preserve meaningful progress, separators between actualcolumns, selectedoutline, aiming guides, track markings and realengine fieldlines; document distinction.

commonCriteria.name: No extra hard layers
commonCriteria.test: Jenga/Crane retain authored environment/gradient while avoiding a new hard sharedheader card. Nested framing needs a distinct task; decorative regionboxing is not grouping.

commonCriteria.name: Phone control usability
commonCriteria.test: Primarytask→relevantstats→hint→controls→feedback reads naturally. Active label and icon readable againsttargetfill; assess enabled/selected/disabled contrast separately. Target≥44CSSpx, pointer cancellation/drag model and footer reserves source-qualified when evidenceavailable.

commonCriteria.name: Actual state & privacy
commonCriteria.test: Compare current rendered state/action availability, input feedback and public/private boundaries. Existing action proofs valid only if dependent source hashes match. Do not infer interaction success from static originals.

commonCriteria.name: Freshness & renderer
commonCriteria.test: Every verdict names original+SHA, actual route/state/nativebridge, capture source start/end and relevantdependencies; failures kept in row matrix. Check settledcompositor at bothTVsizes; neither geometry nor zeroerrors prove composition.
